split: chronological schedule midpoint; first half fitting, second half validation; no contact labels inferred
parameter: one league-wide constant pEffective, P(no rim | missed FG), not physically identified; no zone/block coefficients
fit: pooled first-half immediate clock violations per missed FG; select adjacent grid bracket and linear interpolate; boundary if unbracketed; one selected full-schedule rerun, no refit
observable: missed FG followed within 2 seconds by same-offense shot clock turnover before any individual rebound, defensive rebound, other FG/FT/foul/turnover, or period end; intervening same-offense team offensive rebound allowed; no-rim is NOT assigned as a real label
secondary: clock turnover after individual FG OREB before another shot/FT/foul/rebound; same clock/period ordered events; descriptive only

validationGates.immediateClockRate: selected holdout simulated rate inside game-cluster-bootstrap real 95% interval
validationGates.fgAndThree: absolute bias no worse than baseline + 0.1 percentage point

adoption: only if all gates pass, run 20 seed paired full schedule evaluation under existing franchise+seed method; otherwise retain baseline, report structural failure; no total-turnover retuning
restrictions: no team/player IDs as probability input
all four seasons already seen, within-season event validation only
abstract flight time and independent fresh-possession clock hazard unchanged
no injury data, new source hunt, or new seasons
